Create a visitor#

post/v1/visitors

Requires visitor.create. X-Api-Key is required; sessions are not accepted. Omit projectId only when the key is restricted to exactly one project; global and multiple-project keys must provide it. X-Team-Id is unnecessary and must match the key team when supplied. Unspecified contact, address and attribution values are empty strings. utmTerm and utmContent are accepted but are not returned in this public projection.

Corpo da requisição

projectIdstring (uuid)
utmSourcestring
utmMediumstring
utmCampaignstring
utmTermstring
utmContentstring
clickIdstring
namestring
emailstring
phonestring
addressStreetstring
addressCitystring
addressStatestring
addressZipstring
addressCountrystring
Exemplo
curl -X POST "https://api.trackup.me/v1/visitors" \
  -H "X-Api-Key: $TRACKUP_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "projectId": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000",
  "utmSource": "string",
  "utmMedium": "string",
  "utmCampaign": "string",
  "utmTerm": "string",
  "utmContent": "string",
  "clickId": "string",
  "name": "string",
  "email": "string",
  "phone": "string",
  "addressStreet": "string",
  "addressCity": "string",
  "addressState": "string",
  "addressZip": "string",
  "addressCountry": "string"
}'

Create a conversion#

post/v1/conversions

Requires conversion.create. X-Api-Key is required; sessions are not accepted. Omit projectId only when the key is restricted to exactly one project; global and multiple-project keys must provide it. X-Team-Id is unnecessary and must match the key team when supplied. Value accepts numeric coercion and is rounded to two decimals, then converted into the project currency. An omitted source currency defaults to BRL. Missing transactionId, paymentMethod and visitorId read back as empty strings. Status defaults to paid. A repeated nonempty transactionId with the same status returns DUPLICATE_CONVERSION (409).

Create a refund#

post/v1/refunds

Requires conversion.create. X-Api-Key is required; sessions are not accepted. Omit projectId only when the key is restricted to exactly one project; global and multiple-project keys must provide it. X-Team-Id is unnecessary and must match the key team when supplied. Value accepts numeric coercion and is rounded to two decimals, then converted into the project currency. An omitted source currency defaults to BRL. Missing transactionId, paymentMethod and visitorId read back as empty strings. Matches a paid conversion by transactionId; conversionId is null if none matches. A repeated nonempty transactionId returns DUPLICATE_REFUND (409). The shared input accepts status, but it does not affect the refund.

Create a tracked request#

post/v1/requests

Requires request.create. X-Api-Key is required; sessions are not accepted. Omit projectId only when the key is restricted to exactly one project; global and multiple-project keys must provide it. X-Team-Id is unnecessary and must match the key team when supplied. Missing trafficSource defaults to direct. customData accepts at most 15 top-level keys and 8192 UTF-8 bytes after JSON serialization; omitted or empty customData is returned as null.
